in_sanskrit.name: चण्ड
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: One who is rough, angry, and violent. In Hindu mythology, Chandra, the Moon God, is referred to as Chandra Chandra or Chandra Mouli, where Chandra is represented by this name.

in_hindi.name: चण्डू
in_hindi.long_meaning: Intensely rough, angry, and violent. This name is not commonly used in modern India.

in_tamil.name: சண்டு
in_tamil.long_meaning: Rough, angry, and violent. In Tamil mythology, there is a character named Sambandar who is referred to as 'Sambandar Chantar' or 'Sambandar Channar', where Channar is represented by this name.

in_telugu.name: చెణ్ణు
in_telugu.long_meaning: Rough, angry, and violent. This name is not commonly used in modern Andhra Pradesh or Telangana.

in_marathi.name: Channu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Channu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Channu is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Chandra’, which means moon. In Hindu mythology, the moon is often personified as the god Chandrama, who is a primary deity and is considered the ruler of the night. Thus, the name Channu is an expression of reverence and devotion towards the lunar deity.
